entities.summary: Joseon, a notable figure in the history of South Korea, associated with Joseon Dynasty (1392–1494). Preceded by Early Joseon and King Sejong. Their legacy influenced King Sejong the Great promulgates Hangul — the Korean alphabet and Imjin War and Admiral Yi Sun-sin.
